content.text: Most tutorials about building a digital store focus on the storefront. The storefront is the last thing you should configure. The backend is what makes the store work — and the backend is what most creators get wrong when they try to build without a clear sequence. In Stack 01, Google Apps Script serves as the backend Web App — it receives the NOWPayments webhook, validates the signature, confirms the transaction on-chain, logs the order to Google Sheets, and sends the delivery email via Gmail. In Stack 02, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-13|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]]-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-14|Cloudflare R2]] Workers replaces Apps Script with a faster, more scalable serverless backend that integrates natively with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-works-how-15|supabase]] for order storage and Resend for email delivery. Configure the backend first, set the webhook endpoint URL in NOWPayments second, build the storefront third, and test on mainnet fourth.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The Edge Commerce Stack, built on Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, offers a robust alternative to traditional platforms. By leveraging NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creators can bypass traditional payment gatekeepers, ensuring they receive their earnings without interruption. This infrastructure is battle-tested, having been developed in Zimbabwe, where the team faced similar challenges, and is designed to thrive in environments where others fail.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your crypto store, you'll need a few essential components. First, ensure you have a GitHub account for version control and a Cloudflare account for hosting and backend logic. You'll also need to set up a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing. Additionally, prepare your digital products and have a clear understanding of your target audience and marketing strategy.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The NOWPayments configuration sequence is the same regardless of which stack you are deploying. Create a NOWPayments account — no KYC required, no document upload, no bank account needed. Navigate to the wallet settings and add the wallet addresses for each cryptocurrency you want to accept. USDT on Tron and Bitcoin are the practical starting point for most creators in restricted markets. Generate an API key from the NOWPayments dashboard. Set the webhook endpoint URL in the NOWPayments IPN settings pointing to your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App. Set the webhook secret key — a string you generate that both NOWPayments and your backend know.
Build a crypto store in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is deployed and your payment pipeline is configured, it's time to go live. This is a critical moment, as it's when your infrastructure is put to the test. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can confidently process your first transaction, knowing that your store is built on a solid foundation. The automatic transaction verification provided by NOWPayments ensures that payments are confirmed quickly and securely.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your store grows, so does the importance of scaling your infrastructure. The Edge Commerce Stack is designed with scalability in mind, allowing you to easily handle increased traffic and sales. By leveraging the power of Cloudflare Workers and Supabase, you can ensure that your store remains performant, even under heavy loads, and that your customers always have a seamless shopping experience.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Scale your online business with confidence.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those looking to take their online store to the next level, the Edge Commerce Stack, available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for $197, offers a powerful solution. This stack provides everything needed to deploy a fully functional crypto store, including hosting, backend logic, and payment processing, all in one convenient package.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your crypto store, follow these steps: set up your GitHub and Cloudflare accounts, configure your NOWPayments account, prepare your digital products, deploy your store using the Edge Commerce Stack, configure your payment and delivery pipeline, test your store, and go live. With these steps, you'll be well on your way to building a successful online business, free from the restrictions of traditional platforms.
